items.headline: Spain Dominates Austria in Knockout Opener
items.body: Spain secured a comfortable 3-0 victory over Austria in their Round of 32 clash. The European champions are looking to add a second World Cup title to their history.

items.headline: Portugal Edges Croatia in Thriller
items.body: Portugal narrowly defeated Croatia in a dramatic 2-1 comeback, with Cristiano Ronaldo scoring a penalty. Croatia had an equalizer disallowed by VAR in the final moments, leading to fan protests.

items.headline: Switzerland Advances Past Algeria
items.body: Switzerland secured a 2-1 victory against Algeria to progress to the next stage of the tournament. Goals from Ruben Vargas and Johan Manzambi sealed the win for the Swiss.

items.headline: Australia Faces Egypt in Arlington
items.body: Australia will take on Egypt in a highly anticipated Round of 32 match. Egypt advanced as runners-up from Group G and will look to continue their run.

items.headline: Argentina Meets Cape Verde in Miami
items.body: Group J winners Argentina will face Cape Verde, who progressed as Group H runners-up in their World Cup debut. This match is set to be a challenging encounter for both sides.

metadata.venue: Hard Rock Stadium, Miami Gardens, Florida

items.headline: Colombia Takes on Ghana in Kansas City
items.body: Colombia and Ghana will battle it out in Kansas City for a spot in the next round. Ghana advanced as one of the best third-placed teams from Group L.

items.headline: Ismael Kone Out for Canada
items.body: Canadian midfielder Ismael Kone suffered a fractured leg and underwent emergency surgery, ruling him out for the remainder of the tournament. His absence is a significant blow to Canada's squad.

items.headline: Schlotterbeck Sidelined for Germany
items.body: Germany's Niklas Süle (reported as Nikico Schlottterbeck in source) sustained a rupture of the medial ligament in his left ankle during the match against Ivory Coast. The defender will miss the rest of the World Cup.

items.headline: Raphinha Doubtful for Brazil's Later Stages
items.body: Brazil's Raphinha suffered a muscle injury in the back of his right thigh during the match against Haiti. While there's hope for a return in the final stages, his participation in upcoming matches is highly unlikely.

items.headline: Neymar's Calf Strain Progressing
items.body: Neymar continues to recover from a calf injury, with recent medical tests showing encouraging progress. Optimism is growing for his availability early in the tournament, though he has yet to return to full training.
